$schema_comment: Explicit accepted-risk exceptions for the npm audit CI gate. Empty means every finding at or above threshold fails the build.

exceptions.reason: Official Stellar JavaScript SDK required for Stellar blockchain integration and Horizon path payment APIs.
Transitive dependency required by @stellar/stellar-sdk for Horizon HTTP transport layer.

GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg reports an affected range of <=5.0.7, which covers every version ever published (brace-expansion has never released a 5.x) — there is no fixed release to upgrade to. npm's own suggested fix is downgrading jest to 25.0.0, a 6-year-old major, which is not a real remediation. This is dev-only test tooling (glob pattern matching during test discovery), never shipped in the app bundle or reachable at runtime. Revisit at expiry in case a patched release exists by then.
